import React from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Grid, Card, CardContent, Box, Chip, } from '@mui/material'; import { School as SchoolIcon, Work as WorkIcon, Assignment as AssignmentIcon, CheckCircle as CheckCircleIcon, Pending as PendingIcon, Grade as GradeIcon, } from '@mui/icons-material'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; const StudentDashboard = () => { const { currentUser } = useAuth(); // Mock data - replace with actual API calls later const dashboardData = { stats: { applications: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.length || 0, pendingApplications: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.status === 'pending')?.length || 0, approvedApplications: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.status === 'approved' || app.status === 'admitted')?.length || 0, institutionsApplied: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.type === 'institution')?.length || 0, jobsApplied: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.type === 'job')?.length || 0 }, academic: { gpa: currentUser?.profile?.education?.gpa || 0, totalCredits: currentUser?.profile?.education?.totalCredits || 0, subjects: currentUser?.profile?.education?.academicRecords?.length || 0 } }; const data = dashboardData; return ( {/* Welcome Section */} Welcome back, {currentUser?.profile?.personalInfo?.firstName || 'Student'}! Here's your academic and career journey overview {/* Statistics Grid */} Total Applications {data.stats.applications} All time Pending {data.stats.pendingApplications} Awaiting review GPA Score {data.academic.gpa.toFixed(2)} {data.academic.totalCredits} credits Subjects {data.academic.subjects} Completed {/* Academic Summary */} Academic Summary Overall GPA = 3.5 ? 'success' : data.academic.gpa >= 3.0 ? 'warning' : 'error' } size="small" /> Total Credits Subjects Completed Academic Status = 2.0 ? 'Good Standing' : 'Needs Improvement'} color={data.academic.gpa >= 2.0 ? 'success' : 'error'} size="small" /> {/* Application Status */} Application Status Institution Applications Job Applications Pending Reviews Approved {/* Profile Completion */} Profile Completion Status Personal Information Academic Records Work Experience References {/* Quick Actions */} Ready to Take the Next Step? Your academic profile is looking great! Here's what you can do next:
  • Apply to educational institutions with your strong GPA of {data.academic.gpa.toFixed(2)}
  • Explore job opportunities that match your academic background
  • Add work experience and references to strengthen your job applications
  • Track your application status and receive admission decisions
 ); }; export default StudentDashboard;
